meaning: Statuses describe the explicit local reader scope only, not overall architecture or family completion percentages.
sourceBoundary: Same source-identified closed viewport as chart patterns; most recent 600 visible candles; no hidden warmup; replay uses only the acknowledged prefix.

analysisFamilies.name: Trend
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Actual-time straight-line fit within the analyzed viewport, plus existing causal chart structures.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No extrapolation, future direction, regime or trend profitability claim.

analysisFamilies.name: Comparison
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: First/last close, current close rank, and latest return versus its prior-only baseline.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No cross-asset, fundamental, benchmark or matched competitor comparison.

analysisFamilies.name: Ranking
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Tied midrank of the last close among the selected closes.
analysisFamilies.limitation: Not a probability, forecast or ranking across instruments.

analysisFamilies.name: Change and growth
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Observed close-to-close price change and ROC14.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No fundamental growth or future return estimate.

analysisFamilies.name: Distribution
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Type7 quartiles, median and interquartile range of selected closes.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No inferred probability density or population model.

analysisFamilies.name: Central tendency
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Mean and median of analyzed visible closes.
analysisFamilies.limitation: Only the stated descriptive scope is supported; no entire-family completion claim.

analysisFamilies.name: Variability
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Population close deviation, population adjacent-return deviation and visible-seeded ATR14.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No annualized risk, forward risk, or entire-family completion claim.

analysisFamilies.name: Outliers and anomalies
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Latest adjacent return compared with 20–120 strictly prior contiguous returns using 1.5IQR fences.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No historical event backfill, significance or forecast; zero-IQR and gaps withhold the flag.

analysisFamilies.name: Seasonality and cycles
analysisFamilies.limitation: No tested periodicity model, session calendar or multi-season sample.

analysisFamilies.name: Relationships
analysisFamilies.limitation: No paired independently sourced variables or causal model.

analysisFamilies.name: Lead–lag relationships
analysisFamilies.limitation: No aligned multiple series, causal delay model or validated lag selection.

analysisFamilies.name: Composition
analysisFamilies.limitation: OHLC does not provide a complete parts-of-whole quantity.

analysisFamilies.name: Contribution to change
analysisFamilies.limitation: No identified components or attributable contribution model.

analysisFamilies.name: Concentration
analysisFamilies.limitation: No participant, holdings or activity distribution.

analysisFamilies.name: Segmentation
analysisFamilies.limitation: No independently defined segments and validated grouped comparison.

analysisFamilies.name: Cumulative patterns
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Maximum close-peak-to-later-close drawdown inside the selected window.
analysisFamilies.limitation: Price-series drawdown is not account P/L or a strategy return.

analysisFamilies.name: Benchmarks and targets
analysisFamilies.limitation: No sourced comparator or user-defined target contract.

analysisFamilies.name: Breakpoints
analysisFamilies.limitation: Existing geometric breakouts are not validated statistical change points.

analysisFamilies.name: Forecasting
analysisFamilies.limitation: No fitted out-of-sample forecasting contract or calibrated error evidence.

analysisFamilies.name: Uncertainty
analysisFamilies.limitation: Descriptive variation and R² are not predictive intervals or calibrated uncertainty.

analysisFamilies.name: Statistical significance
analysisFamilies.limitation: No stated null model, sampling assumptions, multiplicity policy or inferential test.

analysisFamilies.name: Sensitivity and scenarios
analysisFamilies.limitation: No validated perturbation/scenario model; price-scale regression tests are correctness checks only.

analysisFamilies.name: Data quality
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Source identity, source/symbol/timeframe, OHLC, finality, observation order and cadence checks.
analysisFamilies.limitation: No independent venue verification or session calendar; elapsed gaps do not prove missing trading.

analysisFamilies.name: Chart integrity
analysisFamilies.implementedScope: Applied chart/source OHLC agreement, viewport bound, replay cutoff and numerical validation.
analysisFamilies.limitation: Display transformations disclosed; corporate adjustments and external data truth are not established.
